fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and columns ("Our Weekly Notebook") discussing Florida governance and law enforcement, including debate over liquor control and enforcement actions affecting Dade County, alongside extensive coverage and advertising tied to the winter season’s entertainment and tourism economy. Content features racing and betting information for Tropical Park, nightlife and club promotions, Miami Beach and Miami social items, and published radio program schedules.
